posts.text: What I’d expect from Zerodha’s US Stock Investing — If Zerodha is launching US stock investing through GIFT City, I’d personally expect: Live FX rates Conversion close to the live market rate with a transparent and minimal FX spread. Minimum commission Ideally similar to IBKR , with very low or zero brokerage and no unnecessary platform fees. Proper tax reporting Clear reports that make Indian tax filing easier, including the required details for Schedule FA and foreign income/capital gains reporting. Same-day deposits and withdrawals Fast transfer both ways without unnecessary delays. Fractio…
